description: Dynamic search filtering switches for job discovery waves

allow_multiple_roles_per_company.description: Candidate welcomes repeating companies (especially tier-1 giants/MNCs) for multiple distinct suitable entry-level/fresher roles.

prioritize_tech_giants_first.description: Prioritize discovery from tier-1 tech giants, global enterprise MNCs, top product companies, and leading financial/fintech firms first.

filter_startups_below_14_lpa.description: Strictly exclude small companies or startups if stated/estimated compensation is below INR 14 LPA.

exclude_companies_with_existing_openings.description: Disabled per user instruction to allow applying to multiple roles across high-tier companies.
